learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn to use position words (Prepositions) like in, on, under, behind, and between to describe where things are.]
warm_up_hook: 📦 Imagine playing Hide and Seek! Are you hiding IN the closet, UNDER the bed, or BEHIND the curtain? The words that tell us WHERE things are hiding are called Prepositions!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Preposition is a 'position word'. It tells us the position of a noun or pronoun compared to something else. It links nouns together like a bridge!

lesson_modules.module_title: ⬆️⬇️ Basic Position Words: In, On, Under
lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'In' when something is inside a space. We use 'On' when something touches the top of a surface. We use 'Under' when something is below another object.
examples_or_templates: [In]: The pencils are in the box.
[On]: The book is on the desk.
[Under]: The dog is sleeping under the tree.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'Behind' when something is hidden at the back. We use 'Between' when something is in the middle of TWO other things.
examples_or_templates: [Behind]: The sun is hiding behind the clouds.
[Between]: Rahul is sitting between Amit and Rohit.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Where is the bird if it is flying higher than the tree?
❓ Fill in the blank: The ball rolled ____ the bed.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with In or On: 'The monkeys are jumping _____ the roof.'
subjective_practice.hint: Is the roof a flat surface they touch from the outside, or is it an enclosed box?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Circle the preposition: 'My house is between a park and a school.'
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the word that tells you WHERE the house is located.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Complete the sentence: 'The thief hid ________ the door.'
subjective_practice.hint: If you don't want to be seen from the front, you stand at the back of the door.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🧸 The Teddy Bear Challenge
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Take a small toy or teddy bear. Ask your parent to give you instructions using prepositions, like 'Put the bear UNDER a chair' or 'Put it BETWEEN two pillows'. See how fast you can do it!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Prepositions are position words that show where a noun is.
⭐ 'In' means inside, 'On' means touching a surface, and 'Under' means below.
⭐ 'Behind' is at the back, and 'Between' is in the middle of two things.
